receiptFieldClarification.allFileSizesAndMtimesUnchangedSinceAfter: The sealed after-inventory stores bytes and SHA-256, not file mtimes. At cleanup, each current size matched the sealed byte count and each current mtime was not later than the after-inventory file mtime. This is a bounded metadata check, not a second historical mtime-map comparison or a new full-payload hash.

exactChecks: All ten target filenames and sizes matched the committed after-inventory
All current write times preceded or equaled the sealed after-inventory file write time
Each file had one hard link and no reparse/symlink attribute
All ten share-denied read handles opened simultaneously before deletion
No matching owned engine or index-reader process was observed
Small metadata/lock files were hashed again
Original pristine and retained consumer payloads, and fourteen archives, had identical size/inode/mtime across deletion; both retained meta.json files had exact expected hashes
Target inventory was rechecked by inode/size/mtime immediately before each unlink
change: Deletion of one completed owned temporary producer test copy only
